# Change Management Policy

Revision: v06. Effective: 2024-03-16. Owner: Head of Platform Engineering.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for change management. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to the systems and suppliers listed in the asset register. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Third parties handling in-scope data are bound by a written agreement that imposes equivalent requirements.
- **R2.** Requests under this policy are approved or declined within 2 working days of submission.
- **R3.** Exceptions to this policy are approved in writing by the document owner and recorded in the exception register.
- **R4.** Interactive sessions expire after 8 hours and require re-authentication.
- **R5.** Devices that store in-scope data are encrypted at rest with a managed key.
- **R6.** This document is reviewed every 24 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R7.** Affected parties are notified within 2 days of a confirmed event.
- **R8.** Test and development environments never hold production data unless it has been anonymised.
- **R9.** All access to in-scope systems is logged, and the logs are protected from modification.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Head of Platform Engineering, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
